Bienvenidos al torneo Salta al Cubo 2025, estamos orgullosos de anunciar el tercer torneo en esta ciudad. El evento contará con 13 categorías oficiales de la WCA distribuidas en 22 rondas.

**POR FAVOR LEER LA PESTAÑA ["IMPORTANTE"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaltaalCubo2025#60554-importante-important) PARA REALIZAR EL REGISTRO CORRECTAMENTE**

---

Welcome to tournament Salta al Cubo 2025, we are pleased to announce the third tournament in this city. The competition will feature 13 official WCA events distributed across 22 rounds.

**PLEASE READ THE ["IMPORTANT"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaltaalCubo2025#60554-importante-important) TAB IN ORDER TO REGISTER SUCCESSFULLY**

items.information:
(BR) Bem-vindos ao segundo Unidavi ao Cubo (2025)
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos de inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_

Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.
Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada)

ATENÇÃO: Inscrições no local serão válidas apenas para o evento 3x3x3 e Pyraminx.

Pedimos também atenção ao fato de que quando cada pessoa for entrar na universidade será necessário fazer um cadastro rápido na portaria.
A universidade pede esse cadastro como medida de segurança.

(EN) Welcome to the second Unidavi ao Cubo (2025)
Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problems with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_

Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.
We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial events awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.)

ATTENTION: On-site registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 and the Pyraminx events.

Also we want to point out that before each person gets in the university they will need to make a quick registration at the entrance.
The university demands this registration for safety standards.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with another WCA competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 9:00 AM.

items.information:
#### Guests are limited to a maximum of 2 per competitor, due to seating limitations in the venue. 

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

venue.name: Lehigh Valley Academy Regional Charter School

items.information:
## LVA students, faculty, and staff must leave their LVA email as a comment on their registration to qualify for free registration. The full registration fee ($20) must be paid, and then qualifying registrations will receive the refund.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
